evals.prompt: TalkBack reads each line of our transaction list item separately and users get lost. Fix it in Compose.
evals.expected_output: A TalkBack specification and Compose changes merging the list item semantics with a meaningful description and custom actions, plus a device test.
expectations: Uses mergeDescendants or equivalent to group the item
Keeps interactive children reachable or exposes them as custom actions
Amount and date are read in a spoken-friendly way
